import heapq

def main():
    N = int(input())
    A = []
    B = []
    X = []
    inf = 10 ** 10

    for _ in range(N - 1):
        Ai, Bi, Xi = map(int, input().split())
        A.append(Ai)
        B.append(Bi)
        X.append(Xi)

    dist = [inf] * N
    dist[0] = 0

    U = []
    heapq.heappush(U, (0, 0))  # (distance, stage index)

    while U:
        current_dist, current_stage = heapq.heappop(U)

        if current_stage == N - 1:
            break

        # Move to the next stage
        if current_stage + 1 < N:
            new_dist = current_dist + A[current_stage]
            if new_dist < dist[current_stage + 1]:
                dist[current_stage + 1] = new_dist
                heapq.heappush(U, (new_dist, current_stage + 1))

        # Move to the stage X[current_stage]
        if X[current_stage] - 1 < N:
            new_dist = current_dist + B[current_stage]
            if new_dist < dist[X[current_stage] - 1]:
                dist[X[current_stage] - 1] = new_dist
                heapq.heappush(U, (new_dist, X[current_stage] - 1))

    print(dist[N - 1])
